description: Generative media API with image and video models from Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, Wan, MiniMax and others; find models, price and run generations, follow or cancel requests, upload input files and read usage.

api.description: Get a presigned URL to PUT an input file to yourself, and the public URL it will have. For most uses files.upload does both steps.

fields.type: image/png | image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/gif | image/webp | audio/x-wav | audio/wav | audio/mpeg | audio/mp3 | audio/mp4 | audio/x-m4a | audio/aac | audio/ogg | audio/flac | audio/x-flac | audio/webm | video/mp4
fields.description: The type of the file you will upload; the PUT must use the same one.
Pass this as a model input (image_url, video_url, audio_url) once the file is uploaded.
A presigned storage URL, good for one hour. PUT the file here with every upload_headers entry and no Higgsfield credentials.

api.description: Upload an image, audio or video file from base64 and get the public URL to pass as a model input. A file already at a public https URL needs no upload: pass that URL to the model.

fields.description: The file’s bytes, base64 encoded (a data: URL prefix is fine). Up to 100 MB.

fields.type: image/png | image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/gif | image/webp | audio/x-wav | audio/wav | audio/mpeg | audio/mp3 | audio/mp4 | audio/x-m4a | audio/aac | audio/ogg | audio/flac | audio/x-flac | audio/webm | video/mp4
fields.description: The file’s type.
Pass this as a model input (image_url, video_url, audio_url). Uploaded files are deleted within seven days, so upload again rather than keeping the URL for later.

api.description: What a generation with these inputs would cost, in US dollars and credits. Free; nothing runs.

fields.description: The model path, for example higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard or kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/text-to-video. Find paths with models.list.
The model's input fields, for example { prompt: 'a quiet alpine lake at sunrise' }. Each model has its own; read them with models.get({ modelPath }).
The estimated price in US dollars, as a decimal string.

api.description: Generate and wait up to waitSeconds (default 10, at most 15) for the output; spends account balance when it completes. Answers like requests.status: queued or in_progress is a job to follow with requests.status, and video usually takes longer than the wait. Outputs expire after 7 days by default.

fields.description: The model path, for example higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard or kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/text-to-video. Find paths with models.list.
The model's input fields, for example { prompt: 'a quiet alpine lake at sunrise' }. Each model has its own; read them with models.get({ modelPath }).
An https URL Higgsfield POSTs the result to when the request finishes (see the requests.completed webhook).

Identifies this one generation. Repeating the same call with the same key returns the original request with no second charge; the same key with a different modelPath, input, webhookUrl or expiresAfter is a 422. Left out, one is generated for this call and its retries and returned as idempotency_key. A caller that replays a step or starts a new script gets a new key each time, so it must pass its own to be safe across attempts.
Seconds to keep the outputs after the request finishes, at least 3600. Default and most accounts’ maximum: 604800 (7 days).
How long the call waits, counted from the start of the submit: default 10 and at most 15 seconds. A request still going then comes back as it stands.

fields.type: queued | in_progress | completed | failed | nsfw | canceled | string
fields.description: queued and in_progress: still running (a queued request can still be canceled). completed: the outputs are in images, video or audio. failed: see error, not charged. nsfw: moderation rejected the input or output, not charged. canceled: canceled while queued, refunded.
When the output files are deleted and their URLs stop working: 7 days after the request finished by default. Copy anything you want to keep before then.

Repeat the call with this key and no second charge is made.

api.description: Queue a generation (image, video…) and get a request id back at once; spends account balance when it completes. Follow it with requests.status until it is completed, failed, nsfw or canceled, or pass webhookUrl. Outputs expire after 7 days by default. Repeating with the returned idempotency_key is never charged twice.

api.description: One model by its path, with its input fields (input_schema). Read this before a generation: every model takes its own fields.

fields.description: The model path, for example higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard or kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/text-to-video. Find paths with models.list.
The model path to pass as modelPath, except where a model’s docs page names another endpoint.
For example text2image, image2video, text2video.
For example image or video.
Not a price (most models say 0.0000). Use generations.estimate.
JSON Schema of the model’s input fields. It drives the Console’s playground, so its defaults can differ from what the API applies when a field is left out: pass the fields you care about.

api.description: Find Higgsfield models by text, output type or operation; includeSchema adds their input fields

fields.description: Free text, for example soul or kling.
For example image or video.
For example text2image, image_edit, text2video, image2video or video2video.
Include each model's input_schema (its input fields). All of them come to about 110 KB, so prefer models.get for one model.
